Preview only. VPN configuration unchanged. WHAT IS SMART ROUTING?
Smart Routing determines how websites and IP addresses are handled.

HOW IS IT DIFFERENT FROM PER-APP VPN?
Per-App VPN selects which Android apps enter the VPN. Smart Routing handles destinations for traffic already entering the VPN.

HOW TO SET UP RULES (WHEN AVAILABLE)
1. Tap Add rule.
2. Enter a domain or IP address.
3. Choose Via VPN, Direct, or Block.
4. Review and apply the rule.

VIA VPN: Uses the active proxy server.
DIRECT: Does not use that proxy and may expose your public IP.
BLOCK: Rejects matching connections.

IMPORTANT
Rule order matters. Domain rules require the destination domain to be known. Apps excluded from Android VPN cannot be controlled by these rules.

This preview does not save or apply routing rules.
